usage: llm-modelbench judge-dumps [-h] (--run-id RUN_ID | --out OUT |
                                  --everything) [--runs-dir RUNS_DIR]
                                  [--rankings-out RANKINGS_OUT]
                                  [--judge {single,panel}]
                                  [--judge-model JUDGE_MODEL] [--ctx CTX]
                                  [--think {auto,on,off}] [--dry-run]
                                  [--force] [--yes] [--mock]
                                  [--runtime-profile RUNTIME_PROFILE]
                                  [--no-ranking-update] [--separate-ranking]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --run-id RUN_ID       one run under --runs-dir
  --out OUT             one explicit run directory
  --everything          scan every run under --runs-dir and process eligible
                        subjective dumps sequentially
  --runs-dir RUNS_DIR   run root for --run-id or --everything
  --rankings-out RANKINGS_OUT
                        rankings database to refresh after judging; default:
                        rankings
  --judge {single,panel}
  --judge-model JUDGE_MODEL
                        local Ollama judge model
  --ctx CTX             judge context override
  --think {auto,on,off}
  --dry-run             scan and print eligibility without calling the judge
  --force               rejudge rows already judged by the same model/mode
  --yes                 approve the printed judge batch without an interactive
                        prompt
  --mock                offline deterministic judge for pipeline testing
  --runtime-profile RUNTIME_PROFILE
                        saved runtime profile; explicit selection takes
                        precedence
  --no-ranking-update   write judgements but skip automatic rankings refresh
  --separate-ranking    generate an isolated rankings-separate/<run-id> report
                        after judging
